title: Repair invalid config.json
prompt: `node app.mjs` crashes because config.json is invalid: it is not parseable JSON and one field has the wrong type. Fix config.json so it parses and satisfies app.mjs's validation, preserving the intended values (the service is named widget-service on port 8080, retries means three attempts, features are alpha and beta). Do not change app.mjs. Verify with `node check.mjs` (exit code 0 means done).
